name: Embroidered Cap with Striped & Polka Dot Brim
description:
KEY FEATURES

  • Premium Material:
    - Crafted from khaki cotton fabric, offering a soft, breathable, and comfortable feel for everyday wear.
    - Designed with a stylish striped or polka dot brim, adding a playful and eye-catching accent to the classic cap silhouette.
    - Features sewn eyelets to help improve ventilation and keep the hat more comfortable during extended wear.
    - Includes an adjustable back closure for a flexible fit that suits most adults and teens.
    - Combines casual comfort with a charming decorative brim design, making it suitable for both daily wear and personalized gifting.
    - Available colors: Red Stripe, Light Blue Stripe, Black Stripe, Pink Stripe, Black Polka Dot, Light Blue Polka Dot, Pink Polka Dot, Red Polka Dot.
     
  • Sizes & Dimensions:
    - Hat sizing: 58 – 60 cm ~ 22.83 – 23.62 in
    - Crown height: 11 cm ~ 4.33 in
    - Brim width: 16.5 cm ~ 6.5 in
    - Brim length: 7.5 cm ~ 2.95 in
     
  • Embroidery areas:
    - Front: 14 x 6 cm ~5.51 x 2.36 in
    - Right side: 4.8 x 4.8 cm ~1.89 x 1.89 in
    - Left side: 4.8 x 4.8 cm ~1.89 x 1.89 in
    - Back: 5.5 x 3 cm ~2.16 x 1.18 in
     
  • Embroidery Technology:
    - Uses high-quality embroidery technology for clean stitching, textured detail, and long-lasting durability.
     
  • 📌 Selling Price:
    - This product has NO stitch surcharge and NO embroidery file conversion fee.
    - The embroidery cost is based on the number of embroidery areas selected by the customer, according to the public price on the Printway system.
     
  • Design File/Embroidery Notes:
    📌 Please carefully read the guidelines for preparing embroidery files or PNG files and the design requirements/limitations before submitting your artwork to ensure the best quality outcome. Please read more details here.
    📌 Important Note: To ensure the embroidery product is clear and detailed, the smallest separate elements and details in your design should be at least 2mm in size.
    - Designs with text:
            + The minimum height should be 1 cm.
            + Maintain a minimum letter spacing of 1.5 mm to ensure clean embroidery and clear readability.
            + Avoid using very thin fonts, especially small serif fonts or script fonts.
    - Thread colors: Compatible with embroidery files that contain up to 15 different thread colors.
    - Avoid designs with:
            + Photographic or gradient-based images,
            + Overly complex or dimensional graphics.
    - Recommended styles:
             + Simple text (bold, sans-serif fonts).
             + Monoline designs.
             + Flat/simple shapes without excessive detail.
     
  • Functional & Usage:
    - Functions as both a fashion cap and a personalized embroidered accessory.
    - Suitable for casual wear, outdoor activities, travel, events, school, clubs, team use, and gifting.
    - Great for everyday styling while adding a unique embroidered touch.
    - Easy to pair with casual outfits for a playful and personalized look.
    - A versatile cap option for both personal use and custom merchandise.
     
  • Perfect Gift for Any Occasion:
    - A charming personalized gift for friends, family, teens, students, teachers, and cap lovers.
    - Perfect for birthdays, holidays, back-to-school, vacations, team gifts, and special events.
    - Ideal for anyone who loves casual accessories with cute stripe or polka dot details.
    - Great for monograms, names, clubs, teams, and personal branding.
    - A stylish gift choice that combines comfort, personality, and practical everyday wear 🧢🎁

 

SPECIFICATION

  • Processing Time: 3 – 5 working days average after payment and all designs updated correctly
  • Shipping Time: 6 – 9 working days on average (US)
  • Packaging: 1x Embroidered Cap with Striped & Polka Dot Brim

 

NOTE

  • Actual color may be slightly different from the image due to different monitor and light effects.
  • Please allow 0.2-0.3 cm differences due to manual measurement.
guideLine:
Print Guidelines

 

  • Below is our complete selection of art templates used for designing within the full printable area of our products. 
  • Each template comes with a .png detailing Safe Area, Bleed, etc. 
  • Download templates and mockups here

 

To use an Art Template:

 

  • Open the Printway template for your selected product in Photoshop or another design program.
  • Insert your artwork in a new layer, placing all important parts of your design within the designated “Safe zone” on the art template to ensure your design will not be cut off during the printing process.
  • If you’re designing drinkware, use the indicated centering lines to ensure your artwork is placed exactly where you’d like.
  • Hide or delete the Art Template layer from your file.
  • Save as an .emb, .png, .jpg, or another accepted file type.
  • You’ve now used a Printway template to create artwork exactly to the recommended specs for that product.

 

To ensure your design prints properly on each product:

 

  • Ensure all important elements of your design are within the safe zone on the product template.
  • Fill the entire design template! The outer edge of the template represents “Bleed Area,” which signifies the areas which may print on the outer edges of your product.
  • Failure to fill the bleed area will likely result in unprinted white unprinted areas around the edge of your product.
